meta.topic: 拍照教学 · 入门三秘诀

scenes.title_en: Secret 1: See More, Note More, Memorize More
scenes.context: 这个是闺蜜在日本拍的，这个是手把手教她拍的。总结三个秘诀：一看多记多背。多看是打开收藏夹看分类的拍照灵感；多背是关键，出门前一周一直训练，对着镜子摆姿势，闭眼立正再重新摆，反复直到身体记住。语域：博主分享，干货教学。
sentences: 这个是我闺蜜在日本拍的，这个是这次旅游我手把手教她拍。
This was taken by my friend in Japan; this time I taught her hands-on.
hands-on（手把手）
多看多记可好说，直接打开我的收藏夹。
Seeing and noting is easy — just open my saved folder.
saved folder（收藏夹）
出门前一周，我一直都在训练。
For a full week before the trip, I trained every day.
trained every day（一直在训练）
paraphrase: 手把手教 → teach hands-on / walk through it step by step
scenes.speak: This was taken by my friend in Japan; this time I taught her hands-on. Seeing and noting is easy — just open my saved folder. For a full week before the trip, I trained every day.

scenes.context: 如果你有头前倾的问题，加上圆肩驼背，根本不出片。体态管理达到姐姐那个级别，走在路上随便卡两张都能出片，有model感。语域：博主分享，体态讲解。
sentences: 如果你有头前倾，加上圆肩驼背，根本不出片。
If you have forward head posture plus rounded shoulders, you'll never look good in photos.
forward head posture（头前倾）；rounded shoulders（圆肩驼背）
看她这随便走两下，都有那种model感。
Just watch her walk — it radiates model energy.
radiates model energy（有model感）
体态到这个级别，随便卡两张都能出片。
At that level of posture, two casual shots will do.
two casual shots will do（随便卡两张都行）
paraphrase: 头前倾 → forward head posture / head-forward stance
圆肩驼背 → rounded shoulders / slouched back
scenes.speak: If you have forward head posture plus rounded shoulders, you'll never look good in photos. Just watch her walk — it radiates model energy. At that level of posture, two casual shots will do.

scenes.context: 大部分拍照的时候其实不舒适，表情容易变成皱眉苦脸。比如拍漂亮饭，肚子很饿还不能吃，但拍出来表情却很享受。观众看到照片会产生共情，如果你的表情痛苦、姿势不享受，观众潜意识就不觉得这是好照片。语域：博主分享，表情讲解。
sentences: 大部分拍照的时候，其实是不舒适的。
Most of the time, being photographed is actually uncomfortable.
being photographed（被拍）
我们的表情很容易变成皱眉苦脸。
Our expressions easily turn into a frown.
turn into a frown（皱眉苦脸）
观众看到照片，是会产生共情能力的。
Viewers empathize with what they see in a photo.
empathize（共情）
paraphrase: 皱眉苦脸 → a frown / a grimace
共情 → empathize / feel with the photo
scenes.speak: Most of the time, being photographed is actually uncomfortable. Our expressions easily turn into a frown. Viewers empathize with what they see in a photo.

scenes.title_cn: 心态：要足够自恋足够不要脸
scenes.title_en: Mindset: Be Confident Enough to Be Shameless
scenes.context: 在外面拍照可能觉得尴尬，这种心态下不可能有好的表情和体态。要足够自恋，足够不要脸，心里想「我现在就是韩国idol，我就是全世界最美」。表情和情绪的调动是相辅相成的，享受拍照过程，眼神才有故事感。语域：博主分享，心态打气。
sentences: 要足够自恋，足够不要脸。
You need to be confident enough to be shameless.
be shameless（不要脸）
心里想：我现在就是韩国idol，我就是全世界最美。
Tell yourself: I'm a K-pop idol, the most beautiful person in the world.
the most beautiful person（全世界最美）
人体的表情和情绪的调动，是相辅相成的。
Facial expressions and emotions feed off each other.
feed off each other（相辅相成）
paraphrase: 不要脸 → be shameless / don't care who's watching
相辅相成 → feed off each other / reinforce each other
scenes.speak: You need to be confident enough to be shameless. Tell yourself: I'm a K-pop idol, the most beautiful person in the world. Facial expressions and emotions feed off each other.

practice: Seeing and noting is easy — just open my saved folder.
Forward head posture plus rounded shoulders will never look good in photos.
Viewers empathize with what they see in a photo.
Be confident enough to be shameless — act like a K-pop idol.
pitfalls: This time I taught her hands-on.
「手把手」用 hands-on，不是 by hand。
The head is forward and shoulder is round.
Forward head posture plus rounded shoulders.
「头前倾」用 forward head posture，「圆肩」用 rounded shoulders。
Viewers empathize with what they see.
Be confident enough to be shameless.
shifts: 用 hands-on（手把手）、saved folder（收藏夹）、model energy（model感）
用 forward head posture（头前倾）、rounded shoulders（圆肩驼背）、slouched（驼背）
说心态只会 don't be shy
用 be shameless（不要脸）、feed off each other（相辅相成）、empathize（共情）
